settings.evaluation: Prepared input observations only, exact L3C Pixel_Epoch, odd local indices of dominant accepted two-motion window. No temporal interpolation. This validates templates within windows, not globally independent predictions.
settings.gauge: Uses offset-aligned dominant window templates. The denominator and fast sign depend on the brightness-split gauge; q is not gauge-invariant. The total reconstruction error is invariant.
settings.interpretation: Candidate fast-feature mask, not cloud probability. Both signs of fast contrast can qualify. Single-slow and unevaluable pixels remain unavailable.
settings.defaults: Exploratory, not calibrated. Sigma=3 native cells is nominally 6 km, not identical to three pixels on the old latitude/longitude grid.
